children: Campbell's is rolling out a new enterprise-wide cost savings program targeting $500 million by fiscal 2030, building on $225 million already achieved under a prior initiative. The plan encompasses plant closures, workforce reductions, and what the company calls an enterprise spend optimization plan to transform how it manages direct and indirect spending. The push reflects ongoing margin pressure from inflation and elevated supply chain costs, including tariff impacts. The company says several actions are already underway, with savings intended to protect margins and support higher investment levels in its brands
